notes: The rollout curriculum for the accelerated two-year adoption plan: 33 parishes launch in Wave 1 (2026–27), the remaining 31 in Wave 2 (2027–28). Written for the people who will actually carry a launch — parish launch leads, Trade Hall stewards, assessor trainers, enrollment leads and scale operators — so every transfer check is performed on the learner's own parish: its school board minutes, its hall, its roster, its numbers. The pack teaches the launch as a repeatable craft, because a plan that 33 parishes run in one year only works if the playbook survives contact with all 33. Wave-2 parishes study the same pack a year early, using a Wave-1 neighbor as their real material.
